entities.name: NadA quinolinate synthase
observations: 302 aa soluble protein with Pfam NadA domain PF02445.22 spanning residues 8–300.
Exact sequence match to reviewed Thermococcus kodakarensis quinolinate synthase Q5JFX9.
Catalyzes quinolinate formation in de novo NAD+ biosynthesis.
Annotated as cytoplasmic; EC 2.5.1.72; GO:0008987, GO:0051539, GO:0034628.

entities.name: Quinolinate synthesis
observations: Iminosuccinate/iminoaspartate plus dihydroxyacetone phosphate yields quinolinate, phosphate, water and proton; Rhea RHEA:25888; EC 2.5.1.72.

entities.name: NadA sequence properties
observations: Length 302 aa; predicted molecular weight 34,084 Da; theoretical pI 6.48; GRAVY −0.214; estimated charge at pH 7 −1.80.
Sequence-derived values assume an unmodified monomer and do not account for ligands or oligomerization.
